hotel.location: Magic Kingdom, Walt Disney World Resort, Lake Buena Vista

day_by_day.morning: No activities scheduled — flight arrives at 13:00
day_by_day.afternoon: Arrive at Orlando International Airport at 13:00. Take the Magical Express or a budget rideshare (Uber/Lyft) to your boutique stay near Magic Kingdom, Walt Disney World Resort, Lake Buena Vista. Check in, unpack, and freshen up. Pick up your park tickets or MagicBands if pre-ordered. Download the My Disney Experience app to plan FastPasses and check wait times. Walk around the hotel grounds and pool area to get oriented.
day_by_day.evening: Head to Disney Springs (free admission, no park ticket needed) via complimentary Disney resort bus. Browse the shops, enjoy live street entertainment, and soak in the Disney atmosphere. Great low-cost way to kick off the trip without using a park day.

meals.breakfast: Eat before or during your flight to save money
meals.lunch: Grab a quick and affordable bite at the airport or a fast-casual spot near check-in — budget around $10–$12 per person
meals.dinner: Disney Springs: Try Earl of Sandwich (sandwiches from $7–$9) or Blaze Fast-Fire'd Pizza ($10–$13 per person) — both are budget-friendly and delicious

day_by_day.notes: Purchase a multi-day park ticket in advance online for significant savings. Consider a 5-day ticket for the best per-day value. Bring a refillable water bottle — Disney water fountains are free. Avoid spending on souvenirs on Day 1; save the budget for experiences.

day_by_day.morning: Early arrival at Magic Kingdom — be at the gates by 8:00 AM for rope drop (park typically opens at 9:00 AM). Head straight to Tomorrowland and ride Space Mountain before lines build. Then hit Big Thunder Mountain Railroad and Splash Mountain (or Tiana's Bayou Adventure). Use the My Disney Experience app to grab Lightning Lane passes for popular rides as soon as you enter.
day_by_day.afternoon: Explore Fantasyland — ride Seven Dwarfs Mine Train, Peter Pan's Flight, and the Haunted Mansion. Watch the Festival of Fantasy Parade (usually around 3:00 PM) from a shaded spot on Main Street U.S.A. Take a midday break at your hotel if needed (resort buses run frequently) to avoid peak heat and crowds from 1:00–3:00 PM.
day_by_day.evening: Return to Magic Kingdom for the evening. Watch the Main Street Electrical Parade and end the night with the spectacular HarmoniUS or Disney Enchantment fireworks show over Cinderella Castle — completely free with park admission. Stay until park close to maximize your ticket value.

meals.breakfast: Grab grab-and-go items from your hotel or a quick continental breakfast — budget $5–$8 per person
meals.lunch: Cosmic Ray's Starlight Café in Tomorrowland — rotisserie chicken, burgers, and salads for $12–$15 per person. One of the best value quick-service spots in the park
meals.dinner: Pecos Bill Tall Tale Inn and Café in Frontierland — hearty Mexican-style bowls and burgers for $13–$16 per person. Load up at the free toppings bar to stretch your meal

day_by_day.notes: Arrive at rope drop to experience the most popular rides with minimal wait times (often under 15 minutes vs. 60–90 minutes later in the day). Wear comfortable shoes and sunscreen — June in Orlando is hot and humid with temperatures reaching 90°F+. Carry a refillable water bottle and stay hydrated throughout the day.

day_by_day.morning: Full day at EPCOT. Take the Disney Skyliner gondola (free for resort guests) for a scenic ride to EPCOT — a unique and fun experience in itself. At rope drop, head to World Discovery and ride Guardians of the Galaxy: Cosmic Rewind (virtual queue — join as soon as the park opens). Then ride Test Track and Mission: SPACE (Green Mission for a family-friendly option).
day_by_day.afternoon: Explore World Showcase, which opens at 11:00 AM. Walk the 1.2-mile World Showcase Promenade and visit pavilions from 11 countries. Enjoy free cultural entertainment, live music, and street performances in each pavilion. Ride Frozen Ever After in the Norway Pavilion and Remy's Ratatouille Adventure in the France Pavilion (grab a Lightning Lane early).
day_by_day.evening: Stay for EPCOT's stunning EPCOT Forever or Luminous: The Symphony of Us nighttime spectacular over World Showcase Lagoon — included with park admission and truly magical. Browse the international shops for affordable souvenirs and snacks.

meals.breakfast: Eat at your hotel before heading out to save money — pack a granola bar or fruit for the gondola ride
meals.lunch: Sunshine Seasons in The Land pavilion — one of EPCOT's best quick-service options with fresh, varied meals (sandwiches, grain bowls, rotisserie chicken) for $12–$15 per person
meals.dinner: World Showcase food stalls — sample small dishes from multiple countries for $5–$9 each. Try a Karamell-Küche caramel treat from Germany ($4–$6) and a crepe from France ($8). Budget $15–$20 total per person for a fun, diverse dinner experience

day_by_day.notes: EPCOT is the most walkable Disney park — comfortable shoes are essential. The Disney Skyliner is a free and scenic transportation option from Caribbean Beach and Art of Animation resorts. If staying near Magic Kingdom, take the resort bus to EPCOT. The International Food & Wine Festival or Flower & Garden Festival may be running in June — check Disney's official site for free garden tours and entertainment included with admission.

day_by_day.morning: Full day at Hollywood Studios. Arrive at rope drop and immediately join the virtual queue for Star Wars: Rise of the Resistance — one of the most immersive theme park experiences in the world. Then ride Slinky Dog Dash in Toy Story Land (shortest waits are at opening). Hit Mickey & Minnie's Runaway Railway next.
day_by_day.afternoon: Explore Galaxy's Edge — browse the Millennium Falcon: Smugglers Run ride and walk through the immersive Black Spire Outpost. Watch the Indiana Jones Epic Stunt Spectacular (check show times in the app) — a free, thrilling live show included with admission. Ride Tower of Terror and Rock 'n' Roller Coaster Starring Aerosmith in the afternoon.
day_by_day.evening: Watch Fantasmic! — a spectacular nighttime show featuring Mickey Mouse, water screens, fire, and beloved Disney characters. Arrive 45–60 minutes early for a good seat (free with park admission). End the evening with a stroll through the beautifully themed park atmosphere.

meals.breakfast: Woody's Lunch Box in Toy Story Land — fun theming with affordable breakfast items like tater tot waffles and breakfast pockets for $6–$9 per person
meals.lunch: Ronto Roasters in Galaxy's Edge — the Ronto Wrap (roasted pork and grilled sausage in a pita) is a fan-favorite for $13–$15 and very filling
meals.dinner: ABC Commissary — reliable quick-service with burgers, chicken, and pasta for $12–$15 per person. One of the more budget-friendly dinner spots in the park

day_by_day.notes: Hollywood Studios is one of the busiest Disney parks — rope drop strategy is critical. Virtual queues for Rise of the Resistance are released at park open and often fill within minutes, so have the app ready. Fantasmic! dining packages exist but are not necessary on a budget — arrive early for free seating. June evenings can still be warm, so bring a light layer just in case of air-conditioned show venues.

day_by_day.morning: Full day at Animal Kingdom. Arrive at rope drop — Animal Kingdom opens early (sometimes 8:00 AM). Head directly to Avatar Flight of Passage in Pandora: The World of Avatar — this is consistently one of the highest-rated theme park rides in the world with the longest wait times. Grab a Lightning Lane if available. Then ride Na'vi River Journey nearby.
day_by_day.afternoon: Explore Africa and ride Kilimanjaro Safaris — best experienced in the morning or late afternoon when animals are most active (afternoon works well here). Walk the Gorilla Falls Exploration Trail (free, no wait) for up-close wildlife encounters. Watch the Festival of the Lion King live show — a Broadway-quality performance included with admission. Explore Asia and ride Expedition Everest.
day_by_day.evening: Stay for Rivers of Light: We Are One nighttime spectacular or Tree of Life Awakening projections — magical, free with admission, and a fitting end to an incredible day in the park. Animal Kingdom typically closes earlier than other parks, so plan accordingly.

meals.breakfast: Grab a quick bite at your hotel or pack snacks to eat on the resort bus to Animal Kingdom
meals.lunch: Satu'li Canteen in Pandora — widely considered one of the best quick-service restaurants at Walt Disney World. Customizable grain bowls and noodle dishes for $13–$17 per person with generous portions
meals.dinner: Flame Tree Barbecue in Discovery Island — smoked ribs, chicken, and pulled pork with beautiful outdoor waterfront seating for $13–$16 per person. A hidden gem for budget dining in the park

day_by_day.notes: Animal Kingdom is the largest Disney park by land area — wear comfortable walking shoes. The park is exceptionally beautiful and lush — take time to appreciate the incredible theming and live animals throughout. Pandora: The World of Avatar is most crowded mid-morning; if you miss rope drop for Flight of Passage, try again in the last 30 minutes before park close. Bring bug spray for the evening hours near the water areas.

day_by_day.morning: Rest and resort day — sleep in and enjoy a relaxed morning. Take advantage of your hotel's pool, which is one of the best budget ways to enjoy a Disney resort day. Many Disney resort pools have themed slides, splash areas, and activities. Alternatively, revisit your favorite park for a half-day using your multi-day ticket.
day_by_day.afternoon: Return to Disney Springs for free daytime exploration. Visit the LEGO Store (free to browse with impressive LEGO sculptures outside), World of Disney (the largest Disney merchandise store in the world — fun to browse even on a budget), and enjoy free live entertainment on the waterfront boardwalk. Check out the Splitsville Luxury Lanes exterior or browse the unique boutique shops.
day_by_day.evening: Head back to Magic Kingdom for a final evening visit. Revisit any rides you loved or missed earlier in the week. Position yourself on Main Street U.S.A. for the best view of the Cinderella Castle fireworks — a magical send-off to your Disney week. Take photos in front of the iconic castle lit up at night.

meals.breakfast: Sleep in and enjoy a relaxed breakfast at your hotel — grab affordable items from a resort food court or nearby grocery store snacks bought earlier in the trip
meals.lunch: Disney Springs: Wolfgang Puck Express — flatbreads, salads, and sandwiches for $12–$15 per person in a casual, no-reservation setting
meals.dinner: Magic Kingdom: Columbia Harbour House in Liberty Square — clam chowder, lobster rolls (budget pick: fried fish and chicken platters for $13–$15), and one of the quieter quick-service spots in the park

day_by_day.notes: This is a great day to do laundry at the resort (most Disney resorts have coin-operated laundry facilities) and repack for departure. Review your spending and set aside any remaining budget for last-minute souvenirs. The Main Street Confectionery is a fun stop for affordable candy and treats ($3–$8). Consider buying discounted Disney merchandise at the end of your trip rather than the beginning.

day_by_day.morning: Enjoy a final leisurely breakfast at your hotel. Check out and store your luggage with the hotel bell services if your flight is later in the day. Take one last walk around the resort grounds and grab photos of the iconic Disney theming. If time allows, hop on a complimentary resort monorail or boat ride for a scenic farewell tour of the Magic Kingdom resort area — both are free and a uniquely Disney experience.
day_by_day.afternoon: Depending on your flight time, spend a final hour or two at Disney Springs (no park ticket needed) for any last-minute souvenir shopping or a farewell treat. Then arrange your rideshare, shuttle, or Magical Express transfer to Orlando International Airport. Arrive at the airport at least 2–3 hours before your flight for international departures.
day_by_day.evening: Fly home with magical memories! Review photos, rest on the plane, and start dreaming about your next Disney adventure.

meals.breakfast: Final hotel breakfast — use up any remaining snacks or grab a quick meal at the resort food court for $8–$12 per person
meals.lunch: Disney Springs quick-service or airport food — budget $12–$15 per person. Grab a last Disney treat like a Mickey-shaped pretzel ($6) or Dole Whip ($6) as a farewell snack
meals.dinner: Airport dining or in-flight meal depending on your departure time and flight

day_by_day.notes: Request a late checkout if possible (usually until 11:00 AM or noon) to maximize your final morning. Bell services will store luggage for free so you can enjoy your last few hours without hauling bags. Orlando International Airport (MCO) has good food options if you have time before your flight. Keep all park receipts and ticket stubs as fun souvenirs. Budget tip: The total estimated food spend for this 7-day trip using quick-service dining is approximately $50–$75 per person per day, keeping your overall meal budget around $350–$525 per person for the week.

day_by_day.morning: Arrival & Check-In — Flight LH lands at 13:00, so no morning activities. Use this time to rest on the plane and prepare your park plans.
day_by_day.afternoon: Airport to Resort Transfer & Hotel Check-In — Take Disney's Magical Express or a rideshare from Orlando International Airport to your Boutique Stay in Magic Kingdom area. Settle into your room, freshen up, and download the My Disney Experience app to confirm Lightning Lane reservations and park passes. Take a leisurely stroll around the resort grounds to get your bearings.
day_by_day.evening: Disney Springs Dining & Entertainment Evening — Head to Disney Springs (complimentary resort shuttle available) for your first taste of Disney magic. Explore the lively outdoor complex with over 60 shops and restaurants, enjoy street performers and live entertainment, and browse iconic stores like World of Disney.

meals.breakfast: Enjoy breakfast on the plane or grab a quick bite at Orlando International Airport before your transfer.
meals.lunch: Grab a casual bite at the resort's quick-service café or food court upon check-in — try a classic burger or wrap to keep it simple and affordable.
meals.dinner: Dinner at The Boathouse at Disney Springs — a mid-range waterfront restaurant offering fresh seafood, steaks, and burgers. Budget ~$25–$45 per person. Alternatively, try D-Luxe Burger for a more budget-friendly option (~$12–$18 per person).

day_by_day.notes: Since arrival is at 13:00, keep the afternoon relaxed and low-key. Avoid booking any major park activities on Day 1 to allow time for travel delays, luggage, and settling in. Purchase any remaining park tickets or dining reservations tonight if not already done. June weather in Orlando is hot and humid (~90°F/32°C) with afternoon thunderstorms common — pack light, breathable clothing and a small rain poncho.

day_by_day.morning: Magic Kingdom Park — Arrive at rope drop (park typically opens at 9:00 AM; aim to arrive by 8:30 AM for early entry if eligible). Head immediately to the most popular rides: Space Mountain, Big Thunder Mountain Railroad, and Seven Dwarfs Mine Train. Use Lightning Lane Multi Pass for top-tier attractions to minimize wait times.
day_by_day.afternoon: Magic Kingdom Continued — After lunch, experience classic attractions including Pirates of the Caribbean, Haunted Mansion, and It's a Small World. Catch the Festival of Fantasy Parade (typically around 3:00 PM) along Main Street U.S.A. for spectacular floats and beloved Disney characters. Take a mid-afternoon break at the hotel if needed to escape the peak heat (2–4 PM).
day_by_day.evening: Magic Kingdom Nighttime Spectacular — Return to Magic Kingdom for the iconic Happily Ever After fireworks show over Cinderella Castle (check the app for showtimes, usually around 9:00 PM). Secure a viewing spot on Main Street U.S.A. at least 30–45 minutes early. Enjoy the magical atmosphere as the park winds down.

meals.breakfast: Breakfast at your resort's on-site restaurant or quick-service food court — try Mickey waffles, a Disney staple! Budget ~$10–$15 per person.
meals.lunch: Columbia Harbour House in Liberty Square — a mid-range quick-service spot offering clam chowder, lobster rolls, and fish & chips. Budget ~$12–$18 per person.
meals.dinner: Be Our Guest Restaurant in Fantasyland (advance reservation strongly recommended) — a beloved mid-range table-service restaurant set inside the Beast's Castle. Prix fixe dinner ~$62 per adult, $37 per child. Alternatively, try Pecos Bill Tall Tale Inn & Café for a budget-friendly quick-service option (~$12–$16).

day_by_day.notes: Magic Kingdom is typically the busiest Disney park — arrive early and use Lightning Lane strategically. Wear comfortable walking shoes and apply sunscreen generously. Stay hydrated throughout the day; free ice water is available at any quick-service location. Check the My Disney Experience app for live wait times and entertainment schedules.

day_by_day.morning: EPCOT World Showcase Food & Culture Tour — Arrive at EPCOT when it opens (typically 9:00 AM). Start with Future World / World Discovery to ride Guardians of the Galaxy: Cosmic Rewind and Test Track early before lines build. Then transition to the World Showcase as it opens around 11:00 AM.
day_by_day.afternoon: EPCOT World Showcase Exploration — Stroll through all 11 country pavilions: Mexico, Norway, China, Germany, Italy, America, Japan, Morocco, France, United Kingdom, and Canada. Sample authentic snacks and small plates from each pavilion — try Norwegian school bread, Japanese gyoza, French crêpes, and Mexican street corn. Ride Remy's Ratatouille Adventure in the France Pavilion and Frozen Ever After in the Norway Pavilion.
day_by_day.evening: EPCOT Harmonious Nighttime Show — Stay for EPCOT's stunning nighttime spectacular over World Showcase Lagoon (check app for showtime, typically 9:00 PM). Enjoy a final international snack or drink while watching the show from the lagoon promenade.

meals.breakfast: Quick breakfast at the resort before departure — grab a pastry and coffee from the resort's grab-and-go market (~$8–$12).
meals.lunch: World Showcase food tour style lunch — budget $20–$30 per person sampling small plates across multiple pavilions. Highlights: Katsura Grill (Japan) for teriyaki bowls, or Tangierine Café (Morocco) for shawarma and hummus.
meals.dinner: Spice Road Table in the Morocco Pavilion — a mid-range waterfront restaurant with Mediterranean small plates and stunning lagoon views. Budget ~$20–$35 per person. Or try La Hacienda de San Angel in Mexico for authentic Mexican cuisine (~$25–$40 per person).

day_by_day.notes: EPCOT is the most food-forward Disney park — bring extra budget for the World Showcase food crawl as it's one of the trip's highlights. The park is large and involves significant walking; wear comfortable shoes. June afternoons bring thunderstorms — carry a compact rain poncho. The Harmonious show is best viewed from the World Showcase promenade near the America pavilion.

day_by_day.morning: Hollywood Studios — Star Wars: Galaxy's Edge Adventure — Arrive at rope drop (typically 9:00 AM; aim for 8:30 AM). Head directly to Star Wars: Galaxy's Edge for Rise of the Resistance (one of Disney's most immersive attractions — Lightning Lane Individual purchase recommended). Then visit Millennium Falcon: Smugglers Run for a hands-on piloting experience.
day_by_day.afternoon: Hollywood Studios Continued — Build your own lightsaber at Savi's Workshop (advance reservation required; ~$259.99 per lightsaber — a premium but iconic experience worth budgeting for if interested). Alternatively, visit Oga's Cantina for themed drinks and atmosphere (~$15–$25 per person; reservations recommended). Also experience Toy Story Land with Slinky Dog Dash and Toy Story Mania. Catch the Indiana Jones Epic Stunt Spectacular if timing allows.
day_by_day.evening: Fantasmic! Nighttime Show & Dinner — Watch Fantasmic!, Hollywood Studios' spectacular outdoor nighttime show featuring Mickey Mouse, water effects, and beloved Disney villains (check app for showtimes). Enjoy the electric atmosphere of Hollywood Boulevard as the park illuminates for the evening.

meals.breakfast: Early breakfast at the resort to fuel up before rope drop — Mickey waffles or a hearty breakfast platter at the resort food court (~$10–$15).
meals.lunch: Docking Bay 7 Food and Cargo in Galaxy's Edge — a themed quick-service restaurant with creative, out-of-this-world menu items like Fried Endorian Tip-Yip (chicken). Budget ~$14–$20 per person.
meals.dinner: Hollywood & Vine — a mid-range buffet-style restaurant with character dining options (check availability). Budget ~$45–$55 per adult. Alternatively, 50's Prime Time Café for nostalgic American comfort food in a fun retro diner setting (~$18–$30 per person).

day_by_day.notes: Savi's Workshop lightsaber building requires an advance reservation and is an additional cost (~$259.99) — decide in advance if this fits your budget. Rise of the Resistance is extremely popular; book Lightning Lane Individual as soon as the booking window opens (7 AM on the day of your visit). Wear Star Wars or Disney-themed attire for extra fun and great photos.

day_by_day.morning: Animal Kingdom — Kilimanjaro Safari & Avatar Land — Arrive at rope drop (typically 8:00 AM — Animal Kingdom opens earliest of all parks). Head immediately to Kilimanjaro Safari to see African wildlife including lions, elephants, giraffes, and hippos in the cool morning hours when animals are most active.
day_by_day.afternoon: Avatar: Flight of Passage & Pandora Exploration — Experience Avatar: Flight of Passage in Pandora – The World of Avatar (Lightning Lane Individual highly recommended — this is one of Disney's most thrilling rides). Explore the bioluminescent world of Pandora on Na'vi River Journey as well. Visit the Gorilla Falls Exploration Trail and Maharajah Jungle Trek for up-close wildlife encounters. Catch a performance of Festival of the Lion King — a spectacular live Broadway-style show.
day_by_day.evening: Rivers of Light & Resort Relaxation — If Rivers of Light or any nighttime entertainment is scheduled, enjoy it before heading back. Animal Kingdom typically closes earlier than other parks (~8:00–9:00 PM in June). Return to the resort for a relaxing evening — enjoy the resort pool, unwind, and recharge for the final days.

meals.breakfast: Grab a quick breakfast at the resort or Flame Tree Barbecue at Animal Kingdom (opens early) — pulled pork, ribs, and smoked chicken. Budget ~$12–$18.
meals.lunch: Satu'li Canteen in Pandora — one of the best quick-service restaurants at Disney World, offering healthy grain bowls, noodle dishes, and unique beverages. Budget ~$14–$20 per person.
meals.dinner: Yak & Yeti Restaurant near Asia — a mid-range table-service restaurant offering pan-Asian cuisine including fried rice, dim sum, and Mandarin chicken. Budget ~$20–$35 per person. Or enjoy a relaxed dinner back at Disney Springs (~15-minute shuttle ride).

day_by_day.notes: Animal Kingdom is best experienced in the early morning when temperatures are cooler and animals are most active on safari. Avatar: Flight of Passage regularly has 90–120 minute standby waits — Lightning Lane is strongly recommended. The park can close earlier than others, so plan your day accordingly. Bring insect repellent as the park has more outdoor, wooded areas.

day_by_day.morning: Resort Day & Magic Kingdom Return — Take a well-deserved slow morning at the resort. Enjoy a leisurely breakfast and spend time at the resort pool. Head to Magic Kingdom mid-morning to catch any attractions missed on Day 2 — Tomorrowland Speedway, Buzz Lightyear's Space Ranger Spin, or The Many Adventures of Winnie the Pooh. Visit Mickey's PhilharMagic for a fun 4D show.
day_by_day.afternoon: Character Meet & Greets & Shopping — Dedicate the afternoon to experiencing character meet & greets at Magic Kingdom (check the app for locations and times — Mickey Mouse, Cinderella, Buzz Lightyear, and others are typically available). Browse Main Street U.S.A. shops for Disney souvenirs, apparel, and collectibles. Visit the Emporium for the widest selection of merchandise.
day_by_day.evening: Farewell Dinner & Resort Celebration — Enjoy a special farewell dinner at a resort restaurant or return to a favorite dining spot from the week. After dinner, watch the Magic Kingdom fireworks one final time from the resort's vantage point (many Magic Kingdom area resorts have partial views of the show) or from the park itself.

meals.breakfast: Leisurely resort breakfast — try the full hot breakfast buffet at the resort restaurant for a relaxed start (~$15–$22 per person).
meals.lunch: Casey's Corner on Main Street U.S.A. — a beloved quick-service spot for hot dogs, corn dog nuggets, and loaded fries with a fun baseball theme. Budget ~$10–$15 per person.
meals.dinner: Celebration dinner at Cinderella's Royal Table inside Cinderella Castle (advance reservation required; prix fixe ~$65–$85 per adult, ~$39 per child) for an unforgettable, special evening. Budget-conscious alternative: The Crystal Palace buffet with Winnie the Pooh characters (~$45–$55 per adult).

day_by_day.notes: Day 6 is intentionally lighter to allow for rest, reflection, and revisiting favorites. Use this day for any missed experiences, souvenir shopping, or simply relaxing by the pool. Saturday is typically one of the busiest days at the parks — if crowds are heavy, consider spending more time at the resort. Confirm your departure logistics tonight: pack bags, arrange transport, and check flight details.

day_by_day.morning: Final Morning Resort Experience — Enjoy a final resort breakfast and take one last walk through the beautiful resort grounds. If checkout allows, spend a couple of hours at the resort pool or explore any last-minute shopping at the resort gift shop. Check out of your room and store luggage with the hotel bell services.
day_by_day.afternoon: Departure Preparation & Optional Disney Springs Visit — If your flight departs in the late afternoon or evening, use the time for a final visit to Disney Springs for last-minute souvenir shopping, a sweet treat at Gideon's Bakehouse (famous for massive cookies — expect a queue!), or a relaxing lunch before heading to the airport. Transfer to Orlando International Airport with plenty of time before your flight.
day_by_day.evening: Departure — Board your return flight home with wonderful memories of a magical week at Walt Disney World. Reflect on the highlights of the trip and start planning your next Disney adventure!

meals.breakfast: Final resort breakfast — enjoy a classic American breakfast or continental spread at the hotel (~$12–$18 per person). Savor it as a relaxed farewell meal.
meals.lunch: Disney Springs farewell lunch — try Chicken Guy! by Guy Fieri for delicious tenders and sauces (~$12–$18 per person) or grab a famous cookie from Gideon's Bakehouse as a sweet send-off (~$6 per cookie).
meals.dinner: Airport dining at Orlando International Airport or on the plane — budget for a simple airport meal (~$15–$25 per person) if your flight departs in the evening.

day_by_day.notes: Allow at least 3 hours before your flight departure for transport to the airport, security, and boarding. Orlando International Airport is approximately 25–30 minutes from Walt Disney World by car/rideshare. Disney's Magical Express (or equivalent resort shuttle) may require advance booking — confirm transfer arrangements the night before. Don't forget to pick up any held packages from Disney park gift shops (items purchased in-park can be delivered to your resort or held at the park exit). Check the My Disney Experience app for any last-minute PhotoPass photos to download before your account session expires.

highlights: Mix of paid and free experiences

trip_options.title: Premium Disney World, Orlando, Florida Escape
trip_options.description: Indulge in the best the destination has to offer. Premium flights, luxury hotels, and exclusive experiences.

experiences.name: Magic Kingdom Park Full Day
experiences.description: Experience the iconic Magic Kingdom with classic rides like Space Mountain, Pirates of the Caribbean, and the Haunted Mansion. Watch the spectacular Festival of Fantasy parade and end the night with the breathtaking Happily Ever After fireworks show over Cinderella Castle.
experiences.location: Magic Kingdom, Walt Disney World Resort, Lake Buena Vista

experiences.name: EPCOT World Showcase Food & Culture Tour
experiences.description: Stroll through EPCOT's World Showcase and sample authentic cuisines from 11 countries including Japan, Morocco, France, and Mexico. Enjoy cultural performances, artisan demonstrations, and themed pavilions that offer a family-friendly global adventure without leaving Florida.
experiences.location: EPCOT World Showcase, Walt Disney World Resort, Lake Buena Vista

experiences.name: Hollywood Studios Star Wars: Galaxy's Edge Adventure
experiences.description: Immerse your family in the Star Wars universe at Galaxy's Edge. Build your own lightsaber at Savi's Workshop, pilot the Millennium Falcon on Smugglers Run, and experience the thrilling Rise of the Resistance ride. A must-do for fans of all ages.
experiences.location: Star Wars: Galaxy's Edge, Hollywood Studios, Walt Disney World Resort

experiences.name: Disney Springs Dining & Entertainment Evening
experiences.description: Spend a lively evening at Disney Springs exploring over 60 dining options, unique shops, and live entertainment. Enjoy dinner at The BOATHOUSE or Rainforest Cafe, catch a show, and browse one-of-a-kind Disney merchandise and experiences — all with no park admission required.
experiences.location: Disney Springs, Walt Disney World Resort, Lake Buena Vista

experiences.name: Animal Kingdom Safari & Avatar Flight of Passage
experiences.description: Embark on a Kilimanjaro Safari to see real African wildlife including lions, elephants, and giraffes roaming vast savannas. Then soar over the bioluminescent world of Pandora on Avatar Flight of Passage, one of Disney's most thrilling and visually stunning rides.
experiences.location: Disney's Animal Kingdom, Walt Disney World Resort, Bay Lake

day_by_day.morning: Arrival & Check-In: Flight LH lands at 13:00 — no morning activities scheduled. Private luxury transfer from Orlando International Airport to Magic Kingdom, Walt Disney World Resort boutique stay via pre-arranged Magical Express or private car service.
day_by_day.afternoon: Resort Orientation & Leisure: Check into your luxury boutique accommodations, unpack, and enjoy a welcome amenity. Take a relaxed stroll around the Magic Kingdom resort area, explore the hotel grounds, pool, and concierge services. Visit the resort's spa for a rejuvenating post-flight treatment or take a dip in the pool.
day_by_day.evening: Disney Springs Dining & Entertainment Evening: Head to Disney Springs for a vibrant first evening. Browse over 60 unique shops, enjoy live entertainment on the waterfront, and soak in the magical atmosphere as an introduction to the Disney World experience.

meals.breakfast: Enjoyed on the flight or at the airport prior to arrival.
meals.lunch: STK Orlando at Disney Springs — upscale modern steakhouse with a lively atmosphere, perfect for a sophisticated post-arrival lunch or late afternoon meal.
meals.dinner: Morimoto Asia at Disney Springs — Iron Chef Masaharu Morimoto's flagship Pan-Asian restaurant offering exquisite dim sum, sushi, and wok specialties in a stunning two-story setting. Reserve the private dining room for an exclusive family experience.

day_by_day.notes: Pre-arrange a private luxury car transfer before departure. Request early check-in through your concierge to ensure the room is ready upon arrival. Ask the concierge to activate your Disney MagicBand+ and set up Lightning Lane Multi Pass for the remainder of the trip. Pack light for the evening — Disney Springs is an outdoor shopping and dining complex with no park admission required.

day_by_day.morning: Magic Kingdom Park — Rope Drop Experience: Arrive at Magic Kingdom at park opening (typically 8:00–9:00 AM) to beat the crowds. Prioritize iconic attractions: Seven Dwarfs Mine Train, Space Mountain, and Big Thunder Mountain Railroad using Lightning Lane Individual selections. Enjoy a character meet-and-greet with Mickey and Minnie at Town Square Theater.
day_by_day.afternoon: Magic Kingdom Continued — Fantasyland & Tomorrowland Deep Dive: Explore Fantasyland with rides including The Many Adventures of Winnie the Pooh, Peter Pan's Flight (Lightning Lane recommended), and Dumbo the Flying Elephant. Visit Tomorrowland for Buzz Lightyear's Space Ranger Spin and Tomorrowland Speedway. Enjoy a mid-afternoon break back at the resort for pool time and a quick refresh.
day_by_day.evening: Magic Kingdom After Dark — Fireworks Spectacular: Return to Magic Kingdom for the evening. Secure a premium reserved fireworks viewing package (Disney Enchantment Fireworks Dessert Party at Tomorrowland Terrace) for front-row views of the iconic castle fireworks display with unlimited desserts and beverages included.

meals.breakfast: Cinderella's Royal Table — Inside Cinderella Castle itself. A character dining experience with Cinderella and Disney Princesses. Book 60 days in advance. Offers a regal prix-fixe breakfast with seasonal dishes and magical ambiance.
meals.lunch: Be Our Guest Restaurant — Dine inside the Beast's enchanted castle in Fantasyland. Order the French-inspired prix-fixe lunch menu in the Grand Ballroom. Reserve well in advance.
meals.dinner: Victoria & Albert's at Disney's Grand Floridian Resort & Spa — AAA Five Diamond Award-winning restaurant considered one of the finest in Florida. Offers an exquisite multi-course Chef's Table tasting menu with wine pairings. Formal attire required. Reservations essential — book 60 days out.

day_by_day.notes: Purchase Lightning Lane Multi Pass and Individual Lightning Lane selections for Seven Dwarfs Mine Train and Peter Pan's Flight the moment the park opens or at 7:00 AM via the My Disney Experience app. The Fireworks Dessert Party requires a separate reservation and sells out weeks in advance — book immediately. Wear comfortable walking shoes and apply sunscreen as June temperatures in Orlando typically reach 90°F+ with high humidity.

day_by_day.morning: Hollywood Studios — Star Wars: Galaxy's Edge Adventure (Early Entry): Utilize Disney Resort guest Early Theme Park Entry (30 minutes before official opening) to access Galaxy's Edge first. Head straight to Rise of the Resistance (Lightning Lane Individual highly recommended) for an immersive, large-scale Star Wars battle experience. Then experience Millennium Falcon: Smugglers Run — pilot the iconic ship on a thrilling mission.
day_by_day.afternoon: Savi's Workshop — Handbuilt Lightsaber Experience & Galaxy's Edge Exploration: Reserve a premium slot at Savi's Workshop to build a custom lightsaber in a ceremonial, Force-themed experience (approximately $299 per lightsaber). Explore Oga's Cantina for exotic themed cocktails and mocktails. Visit Droid Depot to build a custom BB-unit or R-series droid. Explore the Toy Story Land and Twilight Zone Tower of Terror in the afternoon.
day_by_day.evening: Hollywood Studios — Fantasmic! VIP Dining Package & Show: Book the Fantasmic! Dining Package at Mama Melrose's Ristorante Italiano or Hollywood & Vine for a prix-fixe dinner that includes guaranteed reserved seating for the spectacular Fantasmic! nighttime show featuring Mickey Mouse, Disney characters, and stunning water projections.

meals.breakfast: The Grand Floridian Café at Disney's Grand Floridian Resort — Elegant Florida-inspired breakfast with fresh pastries, eggs Benedict, and seasonal fruits. A short monorail ride from the Magic Kingdom resort area.
meals.lunch: Docking Bay 7 Food and Cargo in Galaxy's Edge — Immersive Star Wars-themed quick-service with surprisingly sophisticated dishes like Felucian Garden Spread and Smoked Kaadu Ribs. Enjoy the full atmosphere of Batuu.
meals.dinner: Mama Melrose's Ristorante Italiano (Fantasmic! Dining Package) — Italian-American cuisine with wood-fired flatbreads, pasta, and proteins. Included dining package guarantees Fantasmic! reserved seating.

day_by_day.notes: Savi's Workshop reservations open 60 days in advance and sell out extremely fast — book the moment your window opens. Each reservation allows up to 2 guests per slot with a maximum of 4 guests per session. Rise of the Resistance Lightning Lane Individual is the single most in-demand attraction at Walt Disney World — purchase at exactly 7:00 AM on the day of your visit. Oga's Cantina has a 45-minute maximum stay policy and also requires reservations.

day_by_day.morning: EPCOT — World Discovery & World Nature (Early Entry): Use Resort Early Entry to access EPCOT before crowds. Begin with Guardians of the Galaxy: Cosmic Rewind (virtual queue or Lightning Lane Individual — join virtual queue at exactly park open). Experience Test Track, Mission: SPACE (Orange Mission for the full centrifuge experience), and Soarin' Around the World with Lightning Lane.
day_by_day.afternoon: EPCOT World Showcase Food & Culture Tour: Spend the afternoon leisurely exploring EPCOT's World Showcase — a 1.2-mile promenade featuring 11 country pavilions. Sample authentic cuisines, browse artisan merchandise, and enjoy live cultural entertainment. Stop at Japan (Mitsukoshi Department Store and sushi), France (crêpes and macarons), Morocco (baklava), and Mexico (La Cava del Tequila for premium tequila flights). Enjoy the stunning EPCOT International Flower & Garden Festival (typically April–July) garden displays.
day_by_day.evening: EPCOT — EPCOT Forever / Harmonious Nighttime Spectacular: Stay for EPCOT's breathtaking nighttime spectacular over World Showcase Lagoon. Book the IllumiNations or Harmonious Dessert Party at the Italy Isola or World ShowPlace for reserved lagoon-view seating with premium desserts and beverages.

meals.breakfast: Topolino's Terrace — Flavors of the Riviera at Disney's Riviera Resort: A rooftop character breakfast with Mickey, Minnie, Donald, and Daisy dressed in French Riviera attire. Stunning views and a sophisticated Mediterranean-inspired menu. Easily accessible via Disney Skyliner gondola.
meals.lunch: Le Cellier Steakhouse in EPCOT's Canada Pavilion — One of EPCOT's most coveted reservations. Offers premium Canadian cheddar cheese soup, dry-aged steaks, and an extensive wine list in a cozy château-style setting.
meals.dinner: Monsieur Paul in EPCOT's France Pavilion — An upstairs fine-dining French restaurant inspired by legendary chef Paul Bocuse. Offers classic French haute cuisine including foie gras, duck confit, and soufflé for dessert with an exceptional French wine list.

day_by_day.notes: The EPCOT Dessert Party for the nighttime spectacular sells out weeks in advance — reserve immediately upon booking eligibility. The Disney Skyliner gondola system connects Disney's Riviera Resort, Caribbean Beach Resort, Pop Century, and Art of Animation to EPCOT and Hollywood Studios — a scenic and efficient transportation option. World Showcase doesn't open until 11:00 AM, so plan World Discovery and World Nature for the morning hours.

day_by_day.morning: Animal Kingdom — Kilimanjaro Safari & Avatar Flight of Passage (Early Entry): Arrive at Early Entry opening. Head immediately to Pandora — The World of Avatar. Secure Lightning Lane Individual for Avatar: Flight of Passage — the most immersive and popular ride at Animal Kingdom (and arguably all of Walt Disney World). Experience Na'vi River Journey as well. Then head to Africa for the Kilimanjaro Safari to see lions, elephants, giraffes, hippos, and hundreds of African wildlife species on a 2-mile open-air savanna.
day_by_day.afternoon: Animal Kingdom — Gorilla Falls Exploration Trail & Expedition Everest: Explore the Gorilla Falls Exploration Trail to see western lowland gorillas and exotic birds up close. Ride Expedition Everest — Legend of the Forbidden Mountain, a thrilling Himalayan roller coaster. Enjoy the Festival of the Lion King live theatrical show — a spectacular Broadway-caliber performance. Visit the Tree of Life for stunning up-close views and the It's Tough to Be a Bug! 4D show inside.
day_by_day.evening: Private Resort Relaxation Evening: After two intense park days, enjoy a luxurious evening at your Magic Kingdom boutique resort. Book an in-room dining experience or visit the resort's signature restaurant. Enjoy the resort pool, spa treatments, or a private fireworks viewing from your room or resort grounds if Magic Kingdom fireworks are visible.

meals.breakfast: Tusker House Restaurant at Animal Kingdom — Donald's Safari Breakfast character dining with Donald Duck, Daisy, Mickey, and Goofy in safari attire. Features an African-inspired buffet with bobotie, pap, and other unique offerings alongside American favorites.
meals.lunch: Satu'li Canteen in Pandora — The World of Avatar: A surprisingly elevated quick-service restaurant with fresh grain bowls, protein options, and Pandoran-inspired dishes. Try the Cheeseburger Steamed Pods and Blueberry Cream Cheese Mousse.
meals.dinner: Jiko — The Cooking Place at Disney's Animal Kingdom Lodge: One of Walt Disney World's most acclaimed signature restaurants. Features African-inspired cuisine with wood-fired dishes, an extensive South African wine list (one of the largest outside Africa in the US), and stunning savanna views. Try the maize-crusted lamb chops or oak-grilled filet mignon.

day_by_day.notes: Avatar: Flight of Passage Lightning Lane Individual sells out within minutes of park opening at 7:00 AM — set an alarm. The Kilimanjaro Safari experience is best in the early morning or late afternoon when animals are most active. Disney's Animal Kingdom Lodge offers a free savanna viewing experience even for non-guests — consider visiting after dinner at Jiko to see giraffes and zebras grazing by torchlight. June is peak summer season — stay hydrated and take advantage of the park's numerous misting stations and air-conditioned attractions.

day_by_day.morning: Magic Kingdom — Second Visit & Missed Attractions: Return to Magic Kingdom for a relaxed second visit to catch any missed attractions and revisit favorites. Focus on Haunted Mansion (recently reimagined), Pirates of the Caribbean, and the Jungle Cruise. Visit Liberty Square and Frontierland for a different perspective of the park. Enjoy a leisurely morning without the pressure of first-day crowds.
day_by_day.afternoon: Disney's Grand Floridian Resort Spa & Leisure: Check into a premium spa treatment at the Senses — A Disney Spa at Disney's Grand Floridian Resort & Spa. Choose from signature massages, facials, or a full spa day package. The Grand Floridian is a short monorail ride from the Magic Kingdom resort area. Enjoy the resort's stunning Victorian architecture, multiple pools, and waterfront views of the Seven Seas Lagoon.
day_by_day.evening: Signature Farewell Dinner & Magic Kingdom Fireworks from the Water: Book a private Grand 1 yacht charter (available through Disney's Yacht & Beach Club or marina) for a spectacular private viewing of Magic Kingdom's fireworks from the Seven Seas Lagoon. Enjoy champagne, gourmet appetizers, and a personal crew as you watch Disney Enchantment from the water — an unforgettable luxury experience.

meals.breakfast: 1900 Park Fare at Disney's Grand Floridian Resort — Character breakfast with Cinderella, Prince Charming, and the Evil Stepsisters. Features an elaborate buffet with carving stations, fresh pastries, and seasonal specialties in an elegant Victorian setting.
meals.lunch: Citricos at Disney's Grand Floridian Resort & Spa — A signature Mediterranean-inspired restaurant with stunning views of the resort's courtyard and pool. Offers refined dishes like seared scallops, lamb, and an extensive wine list. Perfect for a leisurely spa day lunch.
meals.dinner: Narcoossee's at Disney's Grand Floridian Resort — A waterfront fine-dining restaurant with panoramic views of the Seven Seas Lagoon and Magic Kingdom. Specializes in premium seafood and steaks. Request a waterfront table for the ultimate fireworks viewing experience before boarding your private yacht charter.

day_by_day.notes: The private Grand 1 yacht charter accommodates up to 18 guests and costs approximately $399–$499 per hour (typically 2-hour minimum). This is one of the most exclusive experiences Walt Disney World offers and must be reserved well in advance through Disney's recreation desk. Senses Spa appointments should be booked 60 days in advance. Saturday is typically one of the busiest days at Walt Disney World — the spa afternoon is a strategic and luxurious way to avoid peak park crowds.

day_by_day.morning: EPCOT or Hollywood Studios — Final Park Morning (Flexible): Based on any remaining must-do experiences, choose one final park for a relaxed morning visit. Recommended: Return to EPCOT for any missed World Showcase pavilions, or Hollywood Studios for Indiana Jones Epic Stunt Spectacular, Muppet*Vision 3D, and the Star Tours — The Adventures Continue ride. Use remaining Lightning Lane selections wisely.
day_by_day.afternoon: Resort Leisure, Souvenir Shopping & Packing: Return to the resort by early afternoon for a final swim, last-minute souvenir shopping at the resort boutique, and leisurely packing. Visit Disney Springs one final time if time allows for any remaining gift purchases — particularly World of Disney (the largest Disney merchandise store in the world) for premium collectibles and memorabilia.
day_by_day.evening: Departure Preparation & Farewell Dinner: Enjoy a final celebratory dinner before arranging private luxury transfer back to Orlando International Airport or preparing for the next leg of travel. Reflect on an extraordinary week of Disney magic.

meals.breakfast: The Contemporary Resort's California Grill Brunch (if available Sunday) OR in-room luxury dining ordered through the resort concierge — enjoy a decadent final morning breakfast with fresh-squeezed juices, pastries, eggs, and seasonal fruits delivered to your room.
meals.lunch: Wolfgang Puck Bar & Grill at Disney Springs — Celebrity chef Wolfgang Puck's flagship Disney location featuring wood-fired pizzas, fresh salads, and American comfort cuisine elevated with premium ingredients. A relaxed, upscale setting perfect for a final afternoon meal.
meals.dinner: California Grill atop Disney's Contemporary Resort — A legendary Walt Disney World dining institution on the 15th floor with sweeping panoramic views of Magic Kingdom and the surrounding resort. Features an innovative seasonal menu of California-inspired cuisine with sushi, wood-fired flatbreads, and premium proteins. Time your reservation to coincide with Magic Kingdom's fireworks — the restaurant dims its lights and plays the fireworks soundtrack for a magical final evening farewell.

day_by_day.notes: California Grill offers complimentary access to their rooftop observation deck for fireworks viewing to all dining guests — present your dining receipt at the Contemporary Resort's main entrance after dinner. Arrange private luxury airport transfer at least 3 hours before your departure flight to account for Orlando traffic and airport security. Request a late checkout from the resort concierge (typically until 1:00–2:00 PM for luxury guests) to maximize your final day without rushing. Download all photos from PhotoPass/Memory Maker before leaving — this premium photo package captures all your Disney moments throughout the week from park photographers and ride photos.
